sources.author: Dyah Kusuma Wardhani, Interior Architecture lecturer, Universitas Ciputra
facts: The street lobby has Art Deco geometric detailing and coloured glazing.
An atrium precedes two garden-facing passages bordered by colonial columns.
A two-storey Presidential Suite sits between the two wings.
sources.inspection: Author-written architectural site account; no accompanying image used.

sources.author: Maureen Nuradi, architectural observations reported in Radar Surabaya
facts: The apparent corridors are long verandas that shade windows and doors.
Both garden wings have curved beams between columns, with Art Nouveau architectural detailing.
No universal measured veranda height is specified; dimensions follow the structure, openings and veranda width.
sources.inspection: Architect’s textual observations read from the university archive; no newspaper photograph adopted.

sources.title: Identification of Colonial Architectural Style in Majapahit Hotel Building and Surabaya Youth Center
facts: Field-study text distinguishes curved gables from triangular pediment variants at the hotel.
The street-facing tower is square and decreases in width toward its top.
White balustrades occur in the hotel hall/balcony area.
Hall roof ornaments include a central rising floral motif and smaller curved/block-shaped flanking elements.
sources.inspection: Published survey-method and building-specific descriptive paragraphs read. Photographs/diagrams are not adopted, reproduced or treated as public-domain references; generic features of Balai Pemuda are not assigned to this hotel.
